verdict.rationale: Auth0 lists email/SMS passwordless and biometrics via WebAuthn and passkeys among its supported login methods (auth0-docs-82). It describes logging in with one-time codes sent by email or SMS (auth0-docs-34) and markets a dedicated passwordless feature with cloud-synced passkeys (auth0-docs-51, auth0-docs-88). WebAuthn also appears as an MFA factor (auth0-docs-38). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of magic-link sign-in, in-depth setup docs for passkeys as a primary login method, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
